injuries.longComment: VanVleet will sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set due to right knee injury management, though he'll likely be able to return for Monday's rematch with Atlanta. In the meantime, Marcus Smart and Reed Sheppard (knee), who is listed as questionable, are candidates for increased burn. If Sheppard is also ruled out, Bruce Thornton could join the rotation.
injuries.shortComment: VanVleet (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.longComment: Missi exited Friday's loss to the Jazz with what the name is now calling a left knee bone bruise. His next chance to suit up will come in Wednesday's rematch against Denver. In the meantime, Derik Queen and Karlo Matkovic are candidates to see increased playing time.
injuries.shortComment: Missi (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nuggets.

injuries.longComment: Curry told reporters after Friday's loss to the Grizzlies that he will "probably not" play Saturday, and the star floor general won't suit up in the second leg of this back-to-back set. With Curry out, a committee of De'Anthony Melton, Will Richard, Brandon Williams and Gary Payton will cover his minutes in the Warriors' backcourt. Curry will aim to return against the Nuggets on Monday.
injuries.shortComment: Curry (rest) won't play Saturday against the Suns.

injuries.longComment: Irving may sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set due to left knee injury management. If the star floor general is held out of Saturday's contest, Marcus Sasser and Sergio de Larrea would be candidates for increased minutes. Naji Marshall could also see increased playmaking duties if Irving joins Cooper Flagg (shoulder) on the inactive list.
injuries.shortComment: Irving (knee) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against San Antonio.
